splits.note: Finish the Act 1 mythic chain, clean the duel board, and remove the loose unlock clutter.

splits.label: NG+ Izuhara Tales and Territory Sweep
splits.note: Front-load the Act 1 tale board and planned liberation work before Castle Kaneda.

splits.label: NG+ Castle Kaneda Exit
splits.note: Close Izuhara clean. Use spare encounters here for any early combat-misc trophy practice still missing.

splits.label: NG+ Akashima Arrival / Umugi Cove
splits.note: Open Toyotama, tag the Umugi line, and start folding side tales into the story spine again.

splits.label: NG+ Yarikawa Story Spine
splits.note: Walls/Coward/Yarikawa route with the nearby cleanup that does not break pace.

splits.label: NG+ Sakai Armor / Omi Loop
splits.note: Family route, Omi loop, and the first Toyotama mythic cluster.

splits.label: NG+ Toyotama Coast Sweep
splits.note: Coastline sweep for lighthouse pressure, collectibles, and easy tale pickups.

splits.label: NG+ Monk and Tale Board
splits.note: Norio side of the island, monk chain setup, and dense Toyotama tale value.

splits.label: NG+ Six Blades / Duel Board
splits.note: Use the Kojiro board to cash out the duel count while it is all in one window.

splits.label: NG+ Toyotama Camp Sweep
splits.note: Liberation-heavy stretch. Good place to mop Perfect Parry, terror arrow, and fall-damage trophy cleanup if needed.

splits.label: NG+ Castle Shimura Exit
splits.note: Close Toyotama with the second dye merchant and any short spillover tale work.

splits.label: NG+ Kamiagata Entry / Jogaku Board
splits.note: Open the north, take the first lighthouse, and set the final side-tale board in motion.

splits.label: NG+ North Sweep / Lighthouse Chain
splits.note: Cold north sweep for lighthouse pressure, tale pickups, and route-safe camp clear.

splits.label: NG+ Frosted Collectibles and Tales
splits.note: Use the frozen region to finish the clean collectible lines and the next block of tales.

splits.label: NG+ Final Mythic / Vanity / Cooper
splits.note: Cash out the last mythic, sword kit/gift cleanup, and the full Cooper Clan costume set.

splits.label: NG+ Kamiagata Territory Sweep
splits.note: Heavy liberation block. This is the best late spot to finish any lingering combat-misc trophy work.

splits.label: NG+ Khan Route
splits.note: Push the final story backbone while keeping the north cleanup board honest.

splits.label: NG+ Lord Shimura / Platinum Mop-Up
splits.note: The route should only leave small spillover here. If anything survives, it should be end-state cleanup, not a region-sized chore.
